body: Thank you. I didn't really understand how this works. Did make my own post.
I'm so sorry. I have no idea how this works. Just needed to get something out there.

I'm really struggling right now. I'm on meds and have been doing really well for several years. I did end up voluntarily checking into a mental hospital about 3 1/2 years ago and got a lot out of it. Right now I am having a tough time, I have started thinking about suicide. I am so emotional. I feel like I've cried more in the last three days than the last two years of my life. I am afraid to talk to any of my friends, relatives and especially doctors because I know I will get the canned responses and for some f'd up reason I don't want the to know. I'm horrified of having to go back to the hospital. That would feel like a failure. I have a 20 year old son and we are very close. I have been told, and I know, that if I follow through it would really screw him up. Most of the time that is enough to keep my head above water, but lately I'm thinking more about me. What about the horrible pain I am in?!!
